name: K-T2
description: The performance comparison of TVC and the own cloud pass (owner order 2026-11-12). Five views (ground at 200 m, inside the cloud layer, above, orbit edge, sky from 200 m) at one universal time chosen by the field as K-T2d chooses its picks (hourly candidates from a fixed base plus a far window of 10 days; the candidate whose cover at 3 km is nearest to 0.65 and at least 0.5, with the sun 30 to 55 degrees up, the wide band 15 to 60 only where the narrow one holds none; the same in every start; each own variant then waits, with its cloud source on, until every layer draws its own map at the clock's time (at most 20 s), the TVC variant 20 s for the painter's maps; -t09DrawnCover chooses the time and the views' heading by what the clouds draw in each view instead), the same camera for every variant, the hold's stable gate (30 frames within 5 m) before each timing window, at 1707x960 and 2560x1440, Medium, A4500, vertical sync off. The definition pins what the player's settings must not decide (key 'settings', written by the runner after the profile and restored with the snapshot): raytracing Off and frame generation off (Medium's raytracing and no pacer behind the GPU frame; the interop and the ray reconstruction would be in every frame), the upscaler's quality NativeAA with qualityAuto off (the render size equals the window size, otherwise Auto renders 1707x960 in both windows; the probe emits T09.view.<name>.render_size and fails when it differs from the window), and the frame cap off (FRAMERATE_LIMIT 1000, the probe reads Application.targetFrameRate back and fails when a cap is set). Built in Release (the CPU rows are Release limits). Own starts (EVE removed, so nothing else draws clouds): off (no clouds from us: the baseline frame), plain (cloud resolution level 1), recon2 and recon3 (levels 2 and 3, one pixel of every 2x2 or 3x3 block per frame; in the views ground, inside and above only), recon4 (level 4), then at the inside view only cache (the light cache on), and cap2 (layer cap 2), and gain (cloud.sunGain and cloud.moonGain reach the pass); edge (edge-adaptive mode) and heightoff (the T13 switches off: their cost = plain minus heightoff) are not in the default list (time) and run with -atmoVariants. Output stage: the product defaults (cloud.sunUnit pi, cloud.exposure 1, cloud.outputGamma 2.2) apply with ownClouds on; the variants set cloud.sunGain only in the gain check. Noise (outside the timing window, after the pictures): for plain and recon2 to recon4 in the views ground and above the probe reads two baseline frames (no layer drawn) and two frames with the pass, each pair on consecutive frames of the held pose, and emits T09.noise.<view>.flicker (mean absolute luminance difference of the two frames in the region the pass changed), floor_flicker (the same for the baseline pair), hf (high-pass RMS, the spatial grain) and their relative forms; kt2.py divides each level by plain. Mods disabled by the runner: EVE in the own starts, Trajectories in all (96 NullReferenceExceptions a run in start 42 added CPU load that hid the GPU cost; ThroughTheEyes (FirstPerson) throws once in the space centre and stays). TVC start (EVE and Scatterer present; the probe fails the start at once without either, waits up to 60 s for the effective source Eve with a bound layer and checks EVE's renderer is Ready): tvc (cloudSource Eve, EVE draws the maps of our field), through the same views, placement, hold, stable gate and clock as the own variants, natural pictures only. The cost of the clouds in a view is the GPU frame of the variant minus the GPU frame of off at the same view and resolution (label independent; TVC against the off of the own start of the same resolution, the universal times are compared by T09.ut_spread_s), cross-checked for the own pass by the GPU profiler's group 'ReDefinition clouds' (the begin and end markers the pass puts around itself; T09.perf.markers_agree). TVC draws its own layer set (the pack's layers plus the painter's layer at 2700 m), the own pass its four layers: the columns compare two systems at the same camera, not equal clouds, and the views 'inside' (4550 m) and 'above' (8300 m) are relative to our layers, not to TVC's. tools/weather_metrics/kt2.py computes the milliseconds from the logs of all starts (the 'metrics' entry); the first TVC report's costliest labels and the labels its pattern matched are in the run's notes. Pictures: after the dwell of each view and variant (outside the timing window) the probe saves a natural picture and, for the own pass, an aid picture (the layer shader's optical-depth heat map over the scene) as t09-<start>-<view>-<variant>-<WxH>-natural.png and ...-aid-opticaldepth.png ('-half' = scaled down by two; full size for the key views of off, plain and tvc); the runner copies them to .local/work/series-pictures/K-T2 and lists them in the result; a fault of the pictures is a named warning ('Probe: warning <name>'), never a failure. A timing series, so the GPU lock is exclusive. Expected results are written in tests/series/rows/T09.json before the run. Run order: own1707 first (it validates the markers, the placement and the clock), then tvc1707.
